# GetStatus

## Rules
- Input `name`; optional `refreshImplementationTracking` defaults true for active only; optional `ifModifiedSince` parsed by `Date.parse`.
- Resolve `changes.get(name)`, then `getDraft(name)`; never discarded storage. Missing → `ChangeNotFoundError` code `CHANGE_NOT_FOUND`.
- Active path resolves schema first. Failure yields read-only `SCHEMA_RESOLUTION_FAILED`, static `validTransitions`, empty available transitions/lifecycle blockers, normal approvals/changePath, `nextArtifact=null`, `schemaInfo=null`; no refresh/reconciliation/mutation. Other check or reconciliation failures propagate.
- After schema success: optionally call `RefreshImplementationTracking.execute({ name })`; then single application reconciler atomically detects/persists validity effects and automatic return. Response uses committed aggregate. Repeated unchanged observation adds no duplicate events. No direct detector or alternative invalidation path.
- Conditional short-circuit occurs only after active refresh/reconciliation. Valid timestamp >= reconciled `updatedAt` may return `unchanged:true`, empty artifacts/blockers, minimal review/action, plus reconciled change and dependencies. Draft may retain read-only revision optimization.
- Draft path conforms `core:drafted-change-view`: `draftView`, no mutable `Change`; `projectArtifacts` only; never `evaluateLifecycle`/`evaluateLifecycleVerdict`; transitions/steps empty, `nextArtifact=null`, no mutating command.
- Full active artifacts: exactly one entry per schema artifact; unattached → `missing`; derive recursive effective/display status via canonical evaluation. File `complete-with-drift` only canonical complete + drift; real states outrank drift display.
- Task-capable artifact reuses `workflow.taskCompletion` check result by type for `{ complete, incomplete, total }`; omit for missing/empty content. `CountTasks` once per evaluation pass, never Kernel-lived cache or second painting call.
- Execute every matching predicate for every protocol-legal target. At `archivable`, also all archive predicates with allow flags false; never hook effects. Checks own I/O; no global snapshot. `evaluateLifecycle` remains I/O-free and supplies public transitions/check rows/next action, never domain `nextHop` command.
- Result exposes implementation files/states and file/symbol links; artifact/workflow policies; review/drift; spec approval/sign-off validity; completed verification evidence separately from active attempt; fingerprint input changes; automatic return; rich `ValidityStatusProjection`, never raw verdict.
- Review and recovery derive from canonical verdict. Required stale spec consent returns to `designing`; stale sign-off alone returns later state to `done`; missing/stale verification blocks only verification-requiring boundaries. Preserve-mode review stays current but blocks forward progress; structural validation never renews consent/evidence.
- Public blockers include review drift/review-required and every failed candidate predicate. `OVERLAP_CONFLICT` only live archive predicate at `archivable`, never overlap invalidation; command remains `/specd-archive`, reason names live overlap and `--allow-overlap`. `--allow-out-of-scope` only failed `impl.linksInScope`, never `impl.filesResolved`. Check blockers include gerund `label`, preferably `checkId`.
- Constructor receives repository, schema provider, approval config, refresh primitive, central reconciler, composed transition/archive checks and bindings. `createGetStatus(config, options?)` delegates through `resolveGetStatusDeps(resolver)` then canonical factory; no `LifecycleEngine`, direct `ImplementationDetector`, filesystem wiring, or duplicate invalidation.
- `changePath = ChangeRepository.changePath(change)`.

## Constraints
- Active status may persist only reconciler-selected validity effects after schema success; draft, archived, schema-unavailable paths read-only.
- Artifact and linked implementation content may be read for fresh facts; ordinary projection avoids unrelated content reads.
- Canonical verdict drives lifecycle, review, blockers, transitions, next action.
- Schema failure degrades fail-closed; subsequent failures propagate.
